verdict.rationale: Epic's dedicated-server docs say a dedicated server "runs headlessly" and "does not render any visuals", with every player connecting as a remote client. Replication docs cover server-to-client synchronization of game state, and Gauntlet docs describe multi-process sessions that include a server, so server-side game logic is clearly first-party. Missing for 10: detailed documentation in the pack of the server build target/packaging steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless server deployment.
